faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (BHU) Varanasi Assistant Project Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Assistant Project Engineer post is 28 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Design or a Master's Degree in Science/Humanities. Additionally, a minimum of one year of relevant experience in the related field is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Project Engineer position is 40 years. Age relaxation may be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Assistant Project Engineer position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of IIT (BHU) Varanasi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Assistant Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Project Engineer position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.answer: The online application process for the Assistant Project Engineer recruitment begins on 8 August 2026.
